IncidentBot: SEV P1 — high tail latency on inference-router in us-west-2 (>1500ms). Auto-page to #eng-oncall. link: https://redwood/incident/1846008123 :rotating_light:
Maria Chen: I'm taking primary. looking at autoscaler + nginx upstreams. starting with pod metrics and queue depth.
Ashwin Patel: on logs, pulling model pool stats and kube events. got a spike around 1846006000.
Jess Ortega: pinging support to surface to affected customers. will collect user-visible symptoms.
Maria Chen: quick mitigation — temporarily shifted traffic to fallback model-variant (quant-8) for heavy routes, and scaled replicas +2. keeping canary for verification.
Ashwin Patel: saw OOMs on a few workers, but restart loop stabilized after scaling. grabbing `kubectl describe pod` & container logs now.
Maria Chen: note — autoscaler didn't trigger early because CPU stayed low, queue depth grew. suspects queuing due to a kernel-level stall on the bert-encoder kernel path.
Tim Nguyen: heads-up — I start my handoff in 18m. can take second responder after you confirm stable @Maria Chen.
Maria Chen: yep @Tim, assign secondary to you when we flip to monitoring state. currently marking as mitigation-in-progress. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: rollback completed — reverted to image `inference-router:v2.4.1-rc` (commit abc123).
IncidentBot: Update — latency improved to 120ms p95, tail down from >1500ms to 200ms. marking status: mitigated, monitoring.
Jess Ortega: Customer impact summary (prelim): ~14 customers experienced 5–30s delays on heavy requests between 03:08–03:40 UTC. 3 generated transient 5xx spikes. CS tickets created: CS-5123, CS-5124. notifying major account contacts.
Ashwin Patel: collecting artifacts for postmortem: `journalctl` dumps, container logs (inference-router-logs-1846008.tar.gz), kernel traces. putting into /artifacts/incidents/1846008123.
Maria Chen: root cause hypothesis: regression in a compiled attention kernel that increases lock contention at certain sequence lengths. appears triggered by a specific prompt pattern + batching configuration.
Jess Ortega: scheduling post-incident review — propose 60m postmortem on Thu 2024-11-14 16:00 UTC (three days out) to include SRE, runtime, ML infra, support. I'll send calendar invite.
Tim Nguyen: works for me. I'll cover the on-call handoff timings and pageflow.
Maria Chen: action items (initial):
  1) [priority P0] Add queue-depth-based autoscaler fallback (owner: Ashwin Patel) — due 2024-11-10.
  2) [priority P1] Update inference-router runbook to include this kernel-stall mitigation + explicit rollback commands (owner: Maria Chen) — due 2024-11-12.
  3) [priority P1] Add targeted synthetic test that reproduces the prompt/seqlen pattern to CI (owner: Jess Ortega / runtime-tests) — due 2024-11-15.
  4) [priority P2] Postmortem doc + RCA draft (owner: Maria Chen/Jess Ortega) — ready before meeting.
  5) [priority P2] Improve alerting threshold: add queue_depth > 500 & sustained tail > 800ms (owner: Ashwin Patel) — due 2024-11-09.
Maria Chen: small runbook snippet to add (please review before I push):
```
If p95 > 500ms AND queue_depth > 200 for > 2m:
  1) Switch traffic to fallback-quant-variant: `rdctl route set inference-router fallback-variant --weight 100`
  2) Scale replicas: `kubectl scale deploy/inference-router --replicas=$(($(kubectl get hpa inference-router -o jsonpath='{.status.desiredReplicas}') + 2))`
  3) Collect logs: `rdctl logs dump --since 30m > /tmp/ir-logs.tar.gz`
  4) If OOMs observed, consider rollback to previous image: `rdctl rollback inference-router --to-image abc123`
```
Ashwin Patel: lgtm, I'll own the alert changes and autoscaler fallback. creating GH issue now: https://github.com/redwood/inference/issues/7894
Jess Ortega: I'll schedule the invite and add CS+PM stakeholders. also will mass-scan for customers affected and attach summary to the postmortem.
Tim Nguyen: on the handoff doc — we should add a short checklist for incoming on-call: `1) check artifacts bucket 2) verify fallback applied 3) confirm no new errors for 15m` — adding to runbook during handoff notes.
Maria Chen: assigning owners in thread: Ashwin = autoscaler & alerts, Maria = runbook update + RCA draft, Jess = postmortem coordination + customer comms, Tim = oncall-handoff doc update.
IncidentBot: INCIDENT RESOLVED — status changed to 'resolved' by Maria Chen. duration: 32m.
Jess Ortega: thanks everyone. I'll post the postmortem doc link once draft is ready and tag action items for tracking. :thumbsup:
Maria Chen: quick follow-up — please ack the action items in GH so we can track. I'll open a PR with runbook edits today.
Ashwin Patel: acked my GH issue and started a branch for autoscaler fallback.
Tim Nguyen: adding the handoff checklist now. will ping when done. :wave:

Jess Ortega: meeting invite sent — 'PM: inference-router latency P1 postmortem' Thu 2024-11-14 16:00 UTC. agenda: timeline, RCA, mitigations, action tracking. please add any pre-read notes in the doc.
Maria Chen: closing note — good quick mitigation. major props to the team for fast rollback + fallback. we'll use this to tighten runbook and alerting.
Tim Nguyen: agreed. good job.
